steps.en: A summary report of uploaded court documents is generated
steps.id: Laporan ringkasan dokumen court yang di-upload dibuat
steps.why_en: Court report menu entries are empty placeholders; no uploaded-document report exists.
steps.why_id: Entri menu laporan court hanya placeholder kosong; laporan dokumen ter-upload tidak ada.

steps.en: Report covers every court case type
steps.id: Laporan mencakup semua jenis court case
steps.why_en: No report by court case type exists for uploads.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada laporan per jenis court case untuk upload.

steps.en: Report lists upload errors, if any
steps.id: Laporan memuat error upload, jika ada
steps.why_en: Upload errors are not recorded because no court upload exists.
steps.why_id: Error upload tidak dicatat karena upload court tidak ada.
